text: So have you unraveled all the secrets of the\nDynamax phenomenon yet?[VAR 0114(0004)]

Oh goodness, no.
The whole thing is still full of questions.\c
I’d hoped that my granddaughter would take
over my research, but...[VAR 0114(0042)]
Dear me, I’m sorry.\nI didn’t even notice my guests![VAR 0114(0042)]
My name is Magnolia.\nWelcome, young Trainers!\r\nNow come, let’s head indoors.[VAR 0114(000A)]
